evals.prompt: Plan three Twitter/X thread options for a tiny desk toy that helps builders ship stuck tasks. The user will approve one option from Telegram, so the options must be judgeable from the message.
evals.expected_output: Routes the X-native thread request to x-thread rather than selecting a social-content method; preserves the explicit publishing boundary; and gives the caller the artifact owner needed for a concrete tweet-by-tweet draft.
assertions: Routes X-native thread requests to x-thread
Does not recreate a social-content:twitter-thread method
Keeps publishing and scheduling outside scope unless explicitly approved

farplane.title: X thread requests route to the dedicated artifact skill
farplane.notes: Regression for the retired social-content:twitter-thread method: X-native thread drafting now has one dedicated artifact owner.
